components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action of a group.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 2px; background: #f3eee2; color: #0b0d12; font: 500 16px/1 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Action Link
components.description: Every action that is not the main one: champagne text with an arrow.
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; color: #d9c9a3; font: 500 16px/1 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Choice Word
components.description: Industries and website examples as plain words; the chosen one ivory and underlined.
components.css: .ds-choice { height: 44px; margin-right: 28px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: #bcb8ae; font: 400 16px 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-choice.is-on { color: #f3eee2; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #d9c9a3; text-underline-offset: 8px; }

narrative.overview: The page is set like an evening edition printed onto the night sky: the turning earth stays behind everything, and the content stands on it as plain text, without a single box. Headings speak in a narrow, upright serif with an italic second half; the reading text is a quiet sans in warm grey. Light comes from ivory type and a few champagne marks, never from glow.
keyCharacteristics: No cards, boards, panels, glass, halos or coloured borders around content.
Instrument Serif 400 for headings, names and prices; Work Sans for reading and controls.
Ivory for type and the one filled button, champagne for links, icons and diagram lines.
A dark veil behind every section after the hero.

rules.name: The No Frame Rule
rules.body: No border, fill, glow or shadow around a group of content; group with space.

rules.name: The One Fill Rule
rules.body: Ivory fill marks exactly one action per group; everything else is a champagne text link.

rules.name: The Roman Statement, Italic Continuation Rule
rules.body: A section heading is a roman ivory statement plus an italic warm-grey continuation.

rules.name: The Air Not Rules Rule
rules.body: Price rows (32px) and questions (48px) are parted by space only; no hairlines between them.

dos: Do group content with 40 to 56px of space on the veiled night ground; part rows of prices and questions by air, not rules.
Do set headings, names and prices in Instrument Serif 400.
Do draw icons as thin champagne lines beside the text.
donts: Don't put cards, glass, glow, halos or coloured borders around content.
Don't bring back light blue or the old line colours; only the intro's glass word keeps its ice-blue rim.
Don't use a bold serif or Bricolage Grotesque.
Don't put hairlines between price rows or questions.
